internal.title: Added assertion re-invokes commitBundle rather than checking preparePushPR's own call
internal.detail: Lines 188-191 call `commitBundle(context.Background(), r.ws, r.bdir, r.slug, "pr body")` a second, separate time to assert `committed==false`. internal.title: Cleanup-empty checkpoints skip op/reason assertions
internal.detail: In TestArchivedPROffersThePushUntilItIsDone (also at line 710), the checks `len(got) != 0` / `len(again) != 0` read `o["cleanup"]` without first asserting `o["op"] == "stop"` and `o["reason"] == stopArchived` (as the earlier and later checkpoints in the same test do, e.g. lines 673-674, 683-684, 722-723). cleanupOf silently returns an empty slice when the "cleanup" key is absent or of the wrong shape, so if `next` regressed to returning a different op entirely at these points, the 'nothing offered' assertions would pass anyway, masking the regression in exactly the rows this test exists to pin (G7's zero-cleanup cases).
